tweets.text: It’s funny, growing up as an immigrant I developed a scarcity mindset around saving money and resources. But when it comes to unlimited token plans and tokenmaxxing, it feels like a missed opportunity if I don’t burn as many tokens as possible and hit the limit each time. How do I address this disconnect? 🥹
